text: Discovery during ilye.2 (closed): the pinned dual-defect test test_validate_full_ipv6_structure_precedes_address_checks does NOT exist anywhere in the repo (grepped py/json/md). 'Update expected messages' in this bead's description is really 'create the test': pin that decode_rule255 of a corrupt-checksum + policy-invalid-source packet reports the checksum error (integrity first) and that decode of structure-valid but policy-invalid packets succeeds byte-preserving (test_vectors.py rule255_endpoint_policy harness branch at ~4715 already covers the second half — this test should pin the dual-defect precedence at the unit level). Also note the 10 failing rule7_* rejection vectors in test_vectors.py are tracked separately (message-drift bead) — do not fold them into this bead.
